literal.prompt: Какой элемент поверхностной циркуляции Арктики усиливается при антициклоническом и ослабевает при циклоническом режиме?

literalGroups.primaryGround: NOAA reports that the Beaufort Gyre strengthens in anticyclonic conditions and weakens under cyclonic conditions (L218-L228@P9). It distinguishes this behavior from the Transpolar Drift, which shifts poleward in cyclonic conditions; NASA independently describes the Beaufort Gyre as a clockwise surface current (L257-L263). The stem contains neither the Beaufort name nor the gyre category, so identifying key0 requires this circulation knowledge.

literalGroups.literal: Это круговорот Бофорта. При антициклоническом режиме он усиливается и вращается по часовой стрелке; при циклоническом ослабевает.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NOAA directly supports the anticyclonic strengthening and cyclonic weakening contrast (L224-L228@P9); NASA reports the clockwise direction (L258-L263).

literalGroups.literal: Круговорот удерживает у поверхности океана пресную воду, поступающую из талой ледниковой воды, рек и осадков.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NASA states the gyre stores freshwater near the surface and collects water from glacial melt, river runoff and precipitation (L258-L259); NOAA describes it as the Arctic Ocean’s major freshwater reservoir (L266-L270@P11).

literalGroups.literal: Антарктическое циркумполярное течение непрерывно движется на восток вокруг Антарктиды.
literalGroups.primaryGround: IPCC identifies the ACC as an eastward-flowing mean current around Antarctica (L1399-L1403@P17); NOAA/AOML says it flows completely around the globe (L149).

literalGroups.literal: Трансполярный дрейф переносит морской лёд от сибирского шельфа к проливу Фрама.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NOAA identifies Transpolar Drift as flow from the Siberian and Russian coasts toward Fram Strait (L224-L228@P9); nearby context concerns coupled sea-ice and surface circulation (L218-L228@P9).

literalGroups.literal: Восточно-Гренландское течение выносит холодную воду и лёд на юг вдоль восточного берега Гренландии.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Icelandic Met Office says the East Greenland Current flows south along Greenland’s east coast and transports sea ice and icebergs (L18-L20).

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Key0 is identified through the anticyclonic/cyclonic response, not by matching a named high or the word “gyre” in the stem. The other options are plausible polar circulation features; the distinct response in NOAA is specific to the Beaufort Gyre. Russian agreement and note are grammatical; note gives an additional useful freshwater fact for this option.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: The Beaufort Gyre stores near-surface freshwater gathered from glacial melt, river runoff and precipitation; this additional option-specific property is absent from the revised stem and answer name.

absoluteDifficulty.audience: Adult with thematic knowledge of Arctic surface circulation. The question requires recalling which regional system strengthens under anticyclonic and weakens under cyclonic conditions; it no longer supplies the Beaufort name or asks for a gyre. It is a one-step domain fact, not technical or multistep reasoning.
